backup_schedules_time_check.name: backup_schedules_time_check
backup_schedules_time_check.value:
length("backup_schedules"."local_time") = 5
    AND substr("backup_schedules"."local_time", 3, 1) = ':'
    AND CAST(substr("backup_schedules"."local_time", 1, 2) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 0 AND 23
    AND CAST(substr("backup_schedules"."local_time", 4, 2) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 0 AND 59

inventory_items_scope_owner_check.name: inventory_items_scope_owner_check
inventory_items_scope_owner_check.value:
("inventory_items"."scope" = 'global' AND "inventory_items"."owner_project_id" IS NULL)
    OR ("inventory_items"."scope" = 'project' AND "inventory_items"."owner_project_id" IS NOT NULL)

inventory_secondary_manufacturers_value_.name: inventory_secondary_manufacturers_value_check
inventory_secondary_manufacturers_value_.value:
("inventory_secondary_manufacturers"."manufacturer_id" IS NOT NULL AND "inventory_secondary_manufacturers"."manufacturer_text" IS NULL)
    OR ("inventory_secondary_manufacturers"."manufacturer_id" IS NULL AND length(trim("inventory_secondary_manufacturers"."manufacturer_text")) > 0)

project_inventory_overrides_content_chec.name: project_inventory_overrides_content_check
project_inventory_overrides_content_chec.value: "project_inventory_overrides"."display_name" IS NOT NULL OR "project_inventory_overrides"."notes" IS NOT NULL

workspaces_system_shape_check.name: workspaces_system_shape_check
workspaces_system_shape_check.value:
("workspaces"."type" <> 'systems') OR (
      "workspaces"."name" = 'Systems'
      AND "workspaces"."icon_key" = 'server'
      AND "workspaces"."color_key" = 'neutral'
      AND "workspaces"."sort_order" = 0
      AND "workspaces"."system_key" = 'systems'
      AND "workspaces"."archived_at_ms" IS NULL
    )

setting_source_metadata_environment_chec.name: setting_source_metadata_environment_check
setting_source_metadata_environment_chec.value:
("setting_source_metadata"."source" = 'environment' AND "setting_source_metadata"."environment_variable" IS NOT NULL)
    OR ("setting_source_metadata"."source" <> 'environment' AND "setting_source_metadata"."environment_variable" IS NULL)
